name: unveo
description: Turn a hackathon project's repo into a judge-ready demo video: the real app recorded in a browser, animated explainers for the hidden logic, a free voiceover.

interface.shortDescription: Turn your hackathon repo into a demo video.
interface.longDescription: Reads your code, records the real web app, animates the hidden logic judges can't see, adds a free English or Hindi voiceover, and renders a 1080p video that fits the time limit.
defaultPrompt: Turn this repo into a 2 minute demo video for the judges.
